lines.text: Welcome back, folks. Marcus Delaney brings the ball up the floor, fourth quarter, three minutes left.
Delaney to Theo Brandt. Brandt drives, he scores! What a move by Theo Brandt.
That puts the Harbor City Hawks ahead, one hundred and two to ninety eight.
Brandt has twenty six points tonight, and the crowd is on its feet.
Timeout called on the floor. We will be right back after this.
